# Queer Love Lounge

> Queer Love Lounge is couples therapy by and for queer and LGBTQIA+ people, led by Lauren Lynch (she/her), an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker. Sessions run online across Australia, and in person sessions in Perth, Western Australia are being planned. Queer Love Lounge is part of Body Belonging Clinic.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: queer and LGBTQIA+ couples, and relationships of more than two. Monogamous, open and polyamorous relationships are all welcome, and trans, nonbinary and gender diverse partners are welcome.
- Clinician: Lauren Lynch (she/her). AMHSW · Gottman Method Level 2 · trained with Esther Perel · a queer led practice.
- How it works: the client is the relationship itself. No taking sides, no Queer 101.
- The method: the Lounge Method. Pull up a chair, find the miss, reach again.
- Where: online across Australia. In person sessions in Perth are being planned; ask to join the list.
- Not provided: crisis or emergency care. In an emergency call 000. For support with family or relationship violence call 1800RESPECT on 1800 737 732. For LGBTQIA+ peer support call QLife on 1800 184 527.

## Fees

- Free 15 minute intro call
- First session: $240, 90 minutes
- Ongoing sessions: $190, 75 minutes
- Pull Up a Chair Intensive: half day, full day and weekend formats, one couple at a time

Couples therapy does not attract a Medicare rebate. Couples sessions are booked after the free call, so we can check together that couples work is the right fit.

## How to start

- Book a free 15 minute call at https://queerlovelounge.com.au
- Email admin@bodybelongingclinic.com.au
